profile.name: KiSuk Nam
profile.bio_ko: GNS3 / Cisco IOS 기반 네트워크 실습 → Linux · Docker · K8s · Cloud 로 확장 중. Learning by building & breaking.
profile.bio_en: Hands-on labs with GNS3 / Cisco IOS, expanding into Linux, Docker, K8s and Cloud. Learning by building & breaking.

extra_projects.summary_ko: HQ/DC/BR1/BR2 4개 사이트를 ISP 이중화(eBGP)와 DMVPN Phase3(mGRE over IPsec)으로 연결. DC는 Arista cEOS, 나머지는 Cisco이며 DC 서버 VLAN에 DNS 이중화와 DB 서버를 배치. HSRP/VARP, QoS, 화이트리스트 ACL, 장애 실측까지 GNS3로 구현.
extra_projects.summary_en: Four sites (HQ/DC/BR1/BR2) joined by dual-ISP eBGP and DMVPN Phase 3 (mGRE over IPsec). Arista cEOS in the DC, Cisco elsewhere, with redundant DNS and a DB server in the DC server VLAN. HSRP/VARP, QoS, whitelist ACLs and failover tests built in GNS3.

extra_projects.summary_ko: Cisco IOS / IOS XE 기반 네트워크 핵심 개념과 설정 정리. VLAN, 라우팅(EIGRP·OSPF), ACL, VPN, STP, EtherChannel, 게이트웨이 이중화까지 27개 문서.
extra_projects.summary_en: Notes on core networking concepts and Cisco IOS / IOS XE configuration: VLAN, routing (EIGRP, OSPF), ACL, VPN, STP, EtherChannel and gateway redundancy, in 27 documents.

extra_projects.summary_ko: Rocky Linux 9 기반 시스템 관리부터 쉘 스크립트, DB, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Python까지 7개 카테고리 90개 문서.
extra_projects.summary_en: System engineering notes from Rocky Linux 9 administration to shell scripting, databases, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and Python: 7 categories, 90 documents.

extra_projects.summary_ko: Cisco 라우팅·스위칭 실습 가이드. RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, 재분배, ACL, 경로 필터링, VLAN·STP·VTP, 스위치 보안을 주제별 통합 정리, 트러블슈팅 치트시트, 퀵 레퍼런스로 구성.
extra_projects.summary_en: Cisco routing and switching lab guide covering RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, redistribution, ACL, route filtering, VLAN/STP/VTP and switch security. Each topic has a consolidated summary, a troubleshooting cheat sheet and a quick reference.

extra_projects.summary_ko: Rocky Linux 9와 Bash 실무 명령어 가이드. 파일시스템, VI, 계정·권한, 압축, 파티션·마운트, RAID 등을 주제별 통합 정리, 트러블슈팅 치트시트, 퀵 레퍼런스로 구성.
extra_projects.summary_en: Practical Rocky Linux 9 and Bash command guide covering the filesystem, VI, accounts and permissions, archiving, partitions and mounts, and RAID. Each topic has a consolidated summary, a troubleshooting cheat sheet and a quick reference.

cisco-dmvpn-ipsec-network.summary_ko: 본사 이중 Edge(허브)와 지사 4곳을 DMVPN Phase2/3(mGRE over IPsec AES-256)으로 연결. OSPF Area 0와 EIGRP AS100/200을 태그 기반 재분배로 통합하고, HSRP Track 이중화, VTPv3, EtherChannel, NAT/PAT까지 GNS3로 구현.
cisco-dmvpn-ipsec-network.summary_en: Dual HQ edge hubs and four branches joined by DMVPN Phase 2/3 (mGRE over IPsec AES-256). OSPF Area 0 and EIGRP AS100/200 are merged with tag-based redistribution, plus HSRP tracking, VTPv3, EtherChannel and NAT/PAT, built in GNS3.
